filters.values: nonblank control-free UTF-8 opaque strings; preserve original full values; no defaults

parameters.required_filters: unique list equal to all filters keys; original-question completeness still B obligation

codec.evidence: Original source codec audit SHA256 8d383430ef4f4a0358c8b7b67c2c21f8d4a787ebea4709b88e09b4a1911ccac4; source audit remains local; public controls are synthetic.
codec.grammar: at-wrapped: @T(@T)*@; otherwise scalar T; T nonblank exact UTF-8 text with no controls, @, comma, semicolon or JSON-looking prefix [/{ after lstrip
codec.raw_preservation: privateIps passed to output exactly; no casefold, IP/IPv6 canonicalization, trimming, int/hex conversion or substring recovery
codec.duplicates: duplicate exact tokens within one VM decoded once, count retained; duplicate object IDs always fail
codec.unproven_encodings: CSV/JSON/scalar_v1 not supported even by explicit opt-in in this revision

roles.selected_eips: exact required EIP predicates, complete current receipt
roles.vm_region_context: one complete same-capture VM population per EIP region, including all unknown address rows
roles.vm_contain_candidates: one explicit literal contain per distinct(region,fixed token); candidate superset only; independent role/lookup receipt

receipt_interface: strict actual request JSON types, explicit http_status and per-page metadata, B verified schema on zero rows, same capture, unique receipt IDs
same_capture_limit: B source assertions cannot be authenticated here; non-atomic capture cannot claim snapshot completeness
SQL_types: all TEXT COLLATE BINARY except known_matching_vm_count INTEGER; true zero-row tables, no _empty rows; A_* never remote CIs
grain: each selected EIP identity x each exact same-region VM token member, or one NULL-VM row if none known
unknown_policy: Known-only retains known results plus all unknown diagnostics. Reject returns unknown_population failure. Unknown addresses never certify no binding.
zero_policy: Verified complete typed zero EIP rows => success rows=[] and no followups. Failed/missing schema/pages never means empty.

failure_interface.evaluate: ok=false,rows=null,error={code,message,details}; preserves unknown diagnostics in rejection details

entrypoints.build: pure staged EIP plan, SQL, typed schemas
entrypoints.plan_followups: explicit per-region context and per-token contain requests
entrypoints.prepare: validate retained staged receipts and derive typed exact member tables
entrypoints.execute_prepared: recompute from retained evidence, check tampering, then offline SQLite only

transport: per request compact UTF-8 provisional4096; block oversize without truncation. B separately measures encoded URL, full envelope and official depth/length.
tenant_298: keep frozen view IDs/params; no PORT policy written here; no address candidate promoted to EIP-object binding
owner_test_results: Original source receipt only; final acceptance summary at ../ACCEPTANCE.json

owner_cli_replay_checks.evidence: Original source receipt only; not included in public payload
